baselineCritiques.lowLevelGoals: The low-level goals are well-defined and directly correspond to the actions a user would take with the calculator app. They cover all essential functionalities for performing basic arithmetic operations, including input, evaluation, display of results, and clearing calculations. baseline.description: This project develops a smartphone app for a simple calculator. In its initial version, it allows the user to do basic calculations. More complex calculations will be considered in subsequent versions that are added iteratively.
highLevelGoals: Provide users with a reliable and intuitive interface to perform fundamental calculations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
lowLevelGoals: Show a virtual keypad with digits 0-9 and basic operation symbols (+, -, *, /) for user input.
Capture and validate user input for numbers and operators in sequence to build an arithmetic expression.
Parse and compute the mathematical expression using a safe evaluation engine to return the result.
Show the final result of the calculation prominently on the screen for user confirmation.
Provide a 'Clear' button or gesture to reset the current input and start a new calculation.
